RNA-seq.readouts: whole-blood transcript abundances and gene expression

evidence.quote: All selected cases had an acute-phase sample collected on days 1–2 of illness and a convalescent sample collected on days 15–17 post-illness for serum, whole blood in PAXgene solution, and PBMCs; these were subject to transcriptomic analysis via RNA-seq, CHIKV viral titer assays, multiplex ELISA for cytokines, and mass cytometry for cellular phenotyping as illustrated in Fig 1 .
